content.title: Orbimed Advisors LLC Acquires New Stake in Upstream Bio Inc
content.summary: On October 15, 2024, Orbimed Advisors LLC, a prominent investment firm, executed a significant transaction by purchasing 4,554,873 shares of Upstream Bio Inc (NASDAQ:UPB), a clinical-stage biotechnology company.  This purchase marks a new holding for the firm, with the shares acquired at a price of $23 each, reflecting a strategic move in the biotechnology sector.  Founded in 1989, Orbimed Advisors LLC has grown from a public equity fund to a global leader in healthcare investment, managing approximately $15 billion across various funds.
